maria.cs: FYI, Horizon onboarding (acct: horizon-inc) seeing lots of 429s right after SDK init. Customer says it starts fine then spikes after a warmup window.

sam.engineering: Can you paste a short log snippet and which SDK/version?

maria.cs: Using browser-js-sdk v0.9.4, auth via ephemeral tokens from our auth proxy. Log: 

maria.cs: ```
[2025-11-04T15:02:03Z] preflight: starting 8 parallel preflights
[2025-11-04T15:02:03Z] auth: fetched 8 ephemeral tokens
[2025-11-04T15:02:04Z] request 200 /api/llm/generate
[2025-11-04T15:02:04Z] request 429 /api/llm/generate
[2025-11-04T15:02:05Z] request 429 /api/llm/generate
```

oliver.devex: looks like a classic preflight fanout -> token storm. Do they create a token per tab/request?

maria.cs: yes, their frontend obtains a token for every worker instance.

ratebot: alert: acct=horizon-inc policy=preflight-concurrency threshold=6 window=10s current=8 :warning:

sam.engineering: Two approaches: (1) short-term quota bump (CS action) to stop immediate throttles, (2) fix client to reuse tokens and debounce preflight. Recommend (2) long-term.

darren.cs: I'll ask ops for a +temporary+ preflight quota for Horizon while we patch. How long would they need?

oliver.devex: Patch options — add a debounce and token pool. Example patch (pseudo):

oliver.devex: ```js
// debounce preflight to avoid N concurrent calls
let preflightInFlight = 0;
const MAX_PREFLIGHT = 3;
async function getToken() {
  if (preflightInFlight >= MAX_PREFLIGHT) {
    await wait(150 + Math.random() * 150); // jitter
    return getToken();
  }
  preflightInFlight++;
  try { return await fetch('/auth/ephemeral'); }
  finally { preflightInFlight--; }
}
```

maria.cs: Good, I'll send that snippet to their eng and propose a 24-48h maintenance window.

sam.engineering: Also ask them to switch to token pooling per session rather than per-request. If they still see 429s after debounce, send me a HAR and we can check header fanout/conn reuse.

darren.cs: Ops said they can do a +25% preflight quota for 48h. I'll coordinate.

maria.cs: Thanks. I'll set up a quick enablement call with Horizon engineers later today and include the code snippet, plus ask for SDK upgrade to v0.9.6 which has small preflight backoff improvements.

oliver.devex: Note: v0.9.6 adds internal preflight jitter and a small default connection pool; should help immediately.

sam.engineering: If they need a hotfix from us, tag me @sam.engineering in the thread after the HAR.

maria.cs: Copy. Scheduling call now, will update thread with results. :phone:
